provenance.geometry: explicit fixed input coordinates in Å; not optimized or measured
provenance.grid: 44×44×44 cube sampling; PySCF default margin 3 bohr
provenance.phase: arbitrary global sign per real canonical MO
provenance.notes: Orbitals are canonical RHF model quantities, not unique observables. Mesh vertices rounded to 0.001 Å; raw grids are downloadable.

orbitals.name: 1σg
orbitals.description: Even phase across the midpoint; amplitude bridges the nuclei.

orbitals.name: 1σu*
orbitals.description: Midpoint nodal plane; phases oppose across the two nuclei.

orbitals.name: π (HOMO)
orbitals.description: The molecular plane z = 0 is a node; the same phase spans both carbon p lobes above it.

orbitals.name: π* (LUMO)
orbitals.description: A second nodal plane bisects C=C, in addition to the molecular plane.

orbitals.name: π(C=O)
orbitals.description: The molecular plane is a node. This occupied π orbital has same-phase carbon and oxygen lobes on each side.

orbitals.name: n(O) (HOMO)
orbitals.description: An oxygen-rich in-plane lone-pair orbital; its shape depends on the chosen canonical-orbital representation.

orbitals.name: π*(C=O) (LUMO)
orbitals.description: The molecular plane and a node between C and O separate the out-of-plane lobes; this is an acceptor orbital in a frontier-orbital account.
